source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The port replaces --in-content-sidebar-width with --size-sidebar at host/root scope and keeps auto. Thunderbird maps global in-content/common.css to its own common sheet, and Preferences requests that URL. The sheet still imports common-shared and layout styles. This proves the comm token override and consumer route; the upstream token implementation and rendered sidebar dimensions remain outside the checked scope.
title: The common stylesheet overrides the new sidebar-size token
